name: gizza-ai/geometry-calculator
summary: Area, perimeter, surface area, and volume of common shapes

tool.description: Calculate area and perimeter for 2D shapes (square, rectangle, triangle, circle, ellipse, trapezoid, parallelogram, regular_polygon) or surface area and volume for 3D shapes (cube, rectangular_prism, sphere, cylinder, cone, pyramid) from their dimensions. Pass the shape plus only the dimensions that shape needs (e.g. circle → radius; rectangle → width, height; cylinder → radius, height). Returns the shape, its dimensionality, the dimensions echoed back, the computed measures with unit suffixes, and a human-readable summary.

base.description: Base length. Used by triangle, trapezoid, parallelogram, and the square base of a pyramid.

height.description: Height. Used by rectangle, triangle, trapezoid, parallelogram, rectangular_prism, cylinder, cone, and pyramid.

radius.description: Radius. Used by circle, sphere, cylinder, and cone.

radius_a.description: Semi-major axis (longer radius). Used by ellipse.

radius_b.description: Semi-minor axis (shorter radius). Used by ellipse.

shape.description: The shape to measure. 2D shapes (square, rectangle, triangle, circle, ellipse, trapezoid, parallelogram, regular_polygon) return area and perimeter; 3D shapes (cube, rectangular_prism, sphere, cylinder, cone, pyramid) return surface area and volume.

side.description: Edge length. Used by square, cube, and regular_polygon.

side_a.description: Side A length. The slant side of a parallelogram; one triangle/trapezoid edge (optional, enables perimeter).

side_b.description: Side B length. A triangle/trapezoid edge (optional, enables perimeter).

side_c.description: Side C length. The third triangle edge (optional, enables perimeter).

sides.description: Number of sides (>= 3). Used by regular_polygon.

top.description: Top (shorter parallel side). Used by trapezoid.

width.description: Width. Used by rectangle and rectangular_prism.
